from scipy.io import wavfile
import scipy.signal as sig

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
sos = sig.butter(8, 3800, 'hp', fs=sr, output='sos')
Lhp = sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, L)

bursts = [(25.162,25.389),(25.441,25.623),(26.196,26.354),(26.414,26.523),
          (26.804,27.094),(27.862,28.101),(29.311,29.677),(30.697,31.028),(32.262,32.498)]

def precise_center(t0,t1):
    ia=int(t0*sr); ib=int(t1*sr)
    seg=Lhp[ia:ib]*np.hanning(ib-ia)
    N=1<<19
    sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg,N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=3800)&(fr<=17000)
    frm=fr[m]; spm=sp[m]
    pk=frm[spm.argmax()]
    # define hump as contiguous region around pk above 0.5*peak of a smoothed spectrum
    from scipy.ndimage import uniform_filter1d
    sm=uniform_filter1d(spm, 200)
    pks=sm.argmax(); pkv=sm[pks]
    lo=pks
    while lo>0 and sm[lo]>0.5*pkv: lo-=1
    hi=pks
    while hi<len(sm)-1 and sm[hi]>0.5*pkv: hi+=1
    # power-weighted centroid in that band
    band=slice(lo,hi)
    cen=(frm[band]*spm[band]**2).sum()/(spm[band]**2).sum()
    return pk, cen

cents=[]
pks=[]
print("burst  peak      centroid")
for k,(t0,t1) in enumerate(bursts):
    pk,cen=precise_center(t0,t1)
    pks.append(pk); cents.append(cen)
    print(f" b{k}  {pk:8.1f}  {cen:8.1f}")

freqs=np.array(cents)
print("\ncentroids:", [round(x,1) for x in freqs])

# search base B: minimize sum of frac distance to nearest integer, weighting
print("\nBase search (centroid freqs):")
best=[]
for B in np.arange(80, 1500, 0.5):
    ratios=freqs/B
    err=np.abs(ratios-np.round(ratios))
    score=err.mean()
    best.append((score,B))
best.sort()
for score,B in best[:12]:
    ratios=freqs/B
    print(f" B={B:7.1f} meanerr={score:.3f} ints={[int(round(x)) for x in ratios]}")

# Also try peaks
freqs2=np.array(pks)
print("\nBase search (peak freqs):")
best=[]
for B in np.arange(80, 1500, 0.5):
    ratios=freqs2/B
    err=np.abs(ratios-np.round(ratios))
    best.append((err.mean(),B))
best.sort()
for score,B in best[:12]:
    ratios=freqs2/B
    print(f" B={B:7.1f} meanerr={score:.3f} ints={[int(round(x)) for x in ratios]}")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
import scipy.signal as sig
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)

seg = L[int(25.0*sr):int(34.4*sr)]

def spec(x, fs, fn, fmax, title, nperseg=4096):
    f,t,S = sig.spectrogram(x, fs, nperseg=nperseg, noverlap=nperseg*7//8)
    Sdb=10*np.log10(S+1e-6); m=f<=fmax
    plt.figure(figsize=(20,8))
    plt.pcolormesh(t, f[m], Sdb[m], shading='auto', cmap='magma'); plt.colorbar()
    plt.title(title); plt.ylabel("Hz"); plt.xlabel("s"); plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(fn, dpi=95); plt.close(); print("saved", fn)

# Original low band 0-4k
spec(seg, sr, "/home/vboxuser/misc-work/mine/orig_lowband.png", 4000, "orig 25-34 0-4kHz", 8192)

# Interpret at half sample rate = play 2x slower, all freqs halved
spec(seg, sr//2, "/home/vboxuser/misc-work/mine/slow2x.png", 8000, "2x slower (freqs/2)", 4096)
# 4x slower
spec(seg, sr//4, "/home/vboxuser/misc-work/mine/slow4x.png", 5000, "4x slower (freqs/4)", 4096)

# SSB-style downshift: multiply by cos to shift band [4500,15000] down by D, lowpass
def downshift(x, D):
    n=np.arange(len(x))
    xc = x*np.exp(-1j*2*np.pi*D*n/sr)
    # lowpass
    sos=sig.butter(8, 8000, 'lp', fs=sr, output='sos')
    y=sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, xc.real)  # keep real (both sidebands) -> actually use complex mag path
    return y
for D in [4400, 4800]:
    y = downshift(seg, D)
    spec(y, sr, f"/home/vboxuser/misc-work/mine/dshift_{D}.png", 8000, f"downshift {D}Hz", 4096)

# save slowed wavs for potential ASR
wavfile.write("/home/vboxuser/misc-work/mine/slow2x.wav", sr//2, (seg/np.abs(seg).max()*20000).astype(np.int16))
wavfile.write("/home/vboxuser/misc-work/mine/slow4x.wav", sr//4, (seg/np.abs(seg).max()*20000).astype(np.int16))
print("wrote slowed wavs")

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
import scipy.signal as sig
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)
sos = sig.butter(8, 3500, 'hp', fs=sr, output='sos')
Lhp = sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, L)

# b1 'oo' vowel 25.441-25.623, b4 26.804-27.094, b6 29.311-29.677
for name,(t0,t1),(flo,fhi) in [("b1",(25.441,25.623),(4000,6000)),
                               ("b4",(26.804,27.094),(4500,6200)),
                               ("b6",(29.311,29.677),(4800,6500))]:
    ia=int(t0*sr); ib=int(t1*sr)
    seg=Lhp[ia:ib]*np.hanning(ib-ia)
    N=1<<20
    sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg,N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=flo)&(fr<=fhi)
    frm=fr[m]; spm=sp[m]
    # peaks
    pk,_=sig.find_peaks(spm, height=spm.max()*0.2, distance=int(40/(fr[1]-fr[0])))
    pf=frm[pk]
    print(f"{name} peaks in {flo}-{fhi}:", [round(x,1) for x in pf])
    if len(pf)>1:
        d=np.diff(pf)
        print(f"   spacings: {[round(x,1) for x in d]}  median={np.median(d):.1f}")

# full-range comb for b4: autocorr of spectrum
t0,t1=26.804,27.094
ia=int(t0*sr); ib=int(t1*sr)
seg=Lhp[ia:ib]*np.hanning(ib-ia)
N=1<<19
sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg,N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
m=(fr>=4000)&(fr<=12000)
spm=sp[m]
spm=spm-spm.mean()
ac=np.correlate(spm,spm,'full')[len(spm)-1:]
df=fr[1]-fr[0]
# find first strong peak in autocorr -> comb spacing in Hz
lagHz=np.arange(len(ac))*df
pk,_=sig.find_peaks(ac[:int(400/df)], height=ac[0]*0.2)
print("\nb4 spectral-autocorr comb-spacing candidates (Hz):", [round(lagHz[p],1) for p in pk[:6]])

import sys, numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
import scipy.signal as sig
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

path = sys.argv[1]
sr, data = wavfile.read(path)
L = data[:,0].astype(np.float64)

sos = sig.butter(8, 3400, 'hp', fs=sr, output='sos')
Lhp = sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, L)
analytic = sig.hilbert(Lhp)
nidx = np.arange(len(Lhp))

model = WhisperModel("small.en", device="cpu", compute_type="int8")

groups = {
 "G1":(25.10,25.70),"G2":(26.15,27.18),"G3":(27.80,28.18),
 "G4":(29.25,29.75),"G5":(30.65,31.10),"G6":(32.18,32.66)}

def downshift(D):
    y=(analytic*np.exp(-1j*2*np.pi*D*nidx/sr)).real
    sos2=sig.butter(8,7800,'lp',fs=sr,output='sos')
    return sig.sosfiltfilt(sos2,y)

def asr_clip(y, rev=False):
    if rev: y=y[::-1]
    y=y/np.max(np.abs(y)+1e-9)
    # pad with 0.3s silence each side to help whisper
    pad=np.zeros(int(0.3*sr))
    y=np.concatenate([pad,y,pad])
    y16=sig.resample_poly(y,16000,sr).astype(np.float32)
    y16=y16/np.max(np.abs(y16)+1e-9)*0.9
    segs,_=model.transcribe(y16,language="en",beam_size=5,
             condition_on_previous_text=False, no_speech_threshold=0.9)
    return " ".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()

for D in [4600, 4800, 5000]:
    ys=downshift(D)
    print(f"\n===== downshift {D}Hz =====")
    for g,(t0,t1) in groups.items():
        clip=ys[int(t0*sr):int(t1*sr)]
        f=asr_clip(clip,False); r=asr_clip(clip,True)
        print(f" {g}: fwd={f!r:40s} rev={r!r}")
